description: Header file defining the C++ class AudioTrackBridge, which encapsulates the Android Java class for audio track management, including methods for playback control, writing samples, and retrieving audio timestamps.

classes.name: AudioTrackBridge
classes.description: Encapsulates Android's Java AudioTrack functionality for use in C++ code, providing methods for playback control, sample writing, and timestamp retrieval.

methods.name: GetMinBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Calculates the minimum buffer size in frames based on sample type, channels, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the audio track bridge and data objects are properly initialized.

methods.name: PauseAndFlush
methods.description: Pauses and flushes the audio buffer.

methods.name: WriteSample
methods.description: Writes audio samples to the track, supporting different sample formats and synchronization.

methods.name: GetAudioTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the current audio timestamp and update time.

methods.name: GetAndResetHasAudioDeviceChanged
methods.description: Checks and resets the flag indicating if the audio device has changed.

methods.name: GetUnderrunCount
methods.description: Returns the number of underrun events.

methods.name: GetStartThresholdInFrames
methods.description: Retrieves the start threshold in frames.
